method: Regex declaration/call search plus manual inspection of cited source ranges; no Java type resolution or gameplay test.

highlights.claim: createShot handles four ProcessType values; default warns not implemented.
Creature spell attack calls createShot and also directly applies ShotData1 as damage, with explicit TODO.
The source uses levelAvailable >= level. Treat this as implementation evidence, not a verified native eligibility rule.
setNextResearchTarget concatenates spells, doors, traps, rooms; upgrades follow discoveries. This method does not consume native Variables type17 records.
Research uses per-definition ResearchTime, with BonusRTime for upgraded KeeperSpells.
Native type17 ResearchOrder is still read as Variable.UNKNOWN_17, grouped with UNKNOWN_0 and UNKNOWN_77.
NextId iterates siblings; ChildId recurses into condition children in this implementation.
Several parsed actions still have TODO bodies in the generic trigger executor.
GENERATE_EFFECT_ELEMENTS and GENERATE_EFFECTS choose which definition table resolves generateIds.
NextEffect starts immediately, with TODO about timing; not proof of native scheduling.
Effect HP is treated as a lifetime in 20 Hz ticks.
EffectElement HP is likewise treated as a lifetime in 20 Hz ticks.
Horizontal origin range uses raw*23/4096, vertical height raw*16/4096 in tile units.
Spin/orientation use 2048 units per turn, with a 20 Hz conversion for rates.
A u16 file field is cast to signed byte for whirlpool direction in the effect simulation.
Effect acceleration is parsedMass*25; friction multiplier is (1-16*parsedFriction)^(20*dt). These are remake formulas, not yet native proofs.
